metadata.description: SpareParts Co answers stock, price and ETA questions for spare parts by part id.
sample_queries: Do you have belt_42 in stock?
What is the price and ETA for pump_17?

tools.name: parts_desk

function.description: Front desk for SpareParts Co: look up real stock, price and ETA for a part id and report the exact result.

request.description: The part id, or the visitor's stock question in plain language.

tools.instructions: You are the SpareParts Co peer. Call website_check_stock with the part id from the request and return its exact result as short plain text. Never invent stock, prices or ETAs.
